_meta.status: source-gating scaffold: verified rows are international anchors only; country-law mappings remain pending until each jurisdiction has dated official/public source objects and expert review
rules: Use verified_international_anchor rows only as international standards, not as proof of local law, ratification, coverage, or remedy path.
Do not treat country_law_placeholder rows as verified facts in model prompts, scoring, public docs, or training data.
Informal publication channels require an archive/date check before they can support a legal claim.
